summary: Ask a protected Poneglyph graph through MCP
need: An agent needs dataset guidance and a read-only way to inspect relationships without receiving database write capability.
value: Dataset-specific query guidance, an observed schema snapshot, and complete typed query results from the selected graph.

stages.action: Connects to the playground's MCP endpoint using an Access-compatible transport.
stages.sees: A read-only MCP server protected by the same account-member Access policy.

stages.action: Calls dataset description and schema tools before constructing a graph query.
stages.sees: Query syntax and limits plus observed fields and value tags at a declared snapshot.

stages.action: Submits a Datalog query against the graph.
stages.sees: Typed result rows or a reported query error; the MCP surface does not expose writes.
